verdict.rationale: Gemini itself functions as an AI assistant/agent (chat app, Gemini Live, Gems) rather than a platform hosting an MCP server for other agents to connect to; the evidence only shows Gemini connecting outward to other apps via its own 'Connected Apps' feature (gemini-docs-10, gemini-docs-33), which is a client-side integration, not an official MCP server exposing Gemini to external agents. Per the agent-role exception, this axis does not apply to Gemini as evidenced.
